info.name: Trillion Digital — Trading API (REST)
info.description:
The REST surface of the Trillion Digital Trading API.

Set `host`, `apiKey`, and `apiSecret` in the environment. The collection-level pre-request script generates a fresh ApiTimestamp and ApiSign before every request — signatures are timestamp-bound and cannot be reused.

SCOPE: the client-facing REST surface is historical OHLCV market data. Order entry, RFQ, execution reports, trades, balances and transfers all run over the WebSocket API, which a static Postman collection cannot represent. See https://docs.trilliondigital.io/trading-api/websocket/overview

The real value of this collection is the signing script — it is the part that is easy to get wrong, and it is reusable for any request you add.

exec: // then HMAC-SHA256 with the API secret, URL-safe base64 (padding retained).
throw new Error('Set host, apiKey and apiSecret in your Postman environment.');
// ISO-8601 UTC with exactly six fractional digits.

request.description:
Historical open/high/low/close/volume bars.

Replace BTC-USD with a symbol published on the Security stream, and 1D with a resolution enabled for your account.

A 200 here proves your key, secret, timestamp format and signature construction are all correct — which is the point of running it first. A 401 means the signature is wrong; see https://docs.trilliondigital.io/trading-api/authentication
